annotations.title: Sats for A$1,000 on Australian exchanges

description: How many sats (1 Bitcoin = 100,000,000 sats) A$1,000 buys right now on each Australian Bitcoin exchange, after deposit fees, trading fees and spread, through its cheapest AUD route. Returns the live ranking (most sats first), the exchanges that are shown but not ranked, each one's all-in cost, data label and reading time, and the BTC/AUD reference price. Checked every 5 minutes. Measured for A$1,000 only; for other amounts the all-in cost is a rough guide. General information, not financial advice.
